import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react'; import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'; import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext'; import { addInquiryEntry, loadAppData } from '../data/store'; import { motion } from 'framer-motion'; import { FaMapMarkedAlt, FaLandmark, FaShoppingCart, FaExternalLinkAlt, FaSignOutAlt, FaUser, FaCar, FaHotel, FaEnvelope, FaCheckCircle } from 'react-icons/fa'; import './Dashboard.css'; const modules = [ { id: 1, title: 'Smart Tourism', description: 'Explore Nilgiris with AR navigation', icon: FaMapMarkedAlt, color: '#2E7D32', gradient: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #2E7D32 0%, #66BB6A 100%)', path: '/smart-tourism', image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1587474260584-136574528ed5?w=600' }, { id: 2, title: 'Tribal Heritage & Culture', description: 'Discover 6 tribal communities', icon: FaLandmark, color: '#FF6B35', gradient: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #FF6B35 0%, #FFB74D 100%)', path: '/tribal-heritage', image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1533105079780-92b9be482077?w=600' }, { id: 3, title: 'Tribal Products', description: 'Shop authentic handmade items', icon: FaShoppingCart, color: '#1976D2', gradient: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #1976D2 0%, #64B5F6 100%)', path: '/tribal-products', image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1472851294608-415105022050?w=600' }, { id: 4, title: 'Badaga Language', description: 'Learn Badaga language resources', icon: FaExternalLinkAlt, color: '#7B1FA2', gradient: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #7B1FA2 0%, #BA68C8 100%)', path: '/badaga-link', image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1543269865-cbf427effbad?w=600' } ]; const quickStats = [ { label: 'Heritage communities', value: '6', tone: 'green' }, { label: 'Smart routes', value: '24/7', tone: 'gold' }, { label: 'Live guides', value: 'AI + AR', tone: 'purple' } ]; const emptyForm = { type: 'general', subject: '', message: '' }; function Dashboard() { const { user, logout } = useAuth(); const navigate = useNavigate(); const [data, setData] = useState(loadAppData()); const [queryForm, setQueryForm] = useState(emptyForm); const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState(''); const featuredProducts = useMemo(() => data.products.slice(0, 3), [data.products]); const featuredHotels = useMemo(() => data.hotels.filter((hotel) => hotel.available).slice(0, 3), [data.hotels]); const featuredTaxis = useMemo(() => data.taxis.filter((taxi) => taxi.available).slice(0, 3), [data.taxis]); const myRequests = useMemo( () => (data.inquiries || []) .filter((inquiry) => inquiry.userEmail && inquiry.userEmail.toLowerCase() === (user?.email || '').toLowerCase()) .sort((a, b) => Number(b.id) - Number(a.id)), [data.inquiries, user?.email] ); const handleModuleClick = (path) => { navigate(path); }; const handleQuickRequest = (type, item) => { const subject = type === 'product' ? `Order request: ${item.name}` : type === 'hotel' ? `Hotel booking: ${item.name}` : `Taxi booking: ${item.name}`; const message = type === 'product' ? `I would like to order ${item.name} for ₹${item.price}. Please share availability and delivery options.` : type === 'hotel' ? `I would like to book ${item.name} in ${item.city} for a stay with ${item.roomsAvailable} rooms available. Please share rates and check-in details.` : `I would like to book ${item.name} at ₹${item.pricePerTrip} per trip. Please confirm taxi availability and pickup timings.`; setQueryForm({ type, subject, message }); setFeedback(''); window.scrollTo({ top: document.body.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth' }); }; const handleQuerySubmit = (event) => { event.preventDefault(); if (!queryForm.subject.trim() || !queryForm.message.trim()) { setFeedback('Please enter a subject and description before submitting.'); return; } addInquiryEntry({ userEmail: user?.email || 'guest@example.com', subject: queryForm.subject.trim(), type: queryForm.type, message: queryForm.message.trim() }); setData(loadAppData()); setQueryForm(emptyForm); setFeedback('Your request has been sent to the admin successfully.'); }; return (

🏔️ AR Smart Tourism

Welcome to Nilgiris Heritage App

{user?.email}
Live Nilgiris experience

Explore the hills with cultural depth and smart travel guidance.

Discover heritage, local craft, tourism routes, and community stories designed for a richer visit to the Nilgiris.

{quickStats.map((stat) => (
{stat.value} {stat.label}
))}

Tea & Tribal Products

{featuredProducts.map((product) => (
{product.category} {product.inStock ? 'Available' : 'Out of stock'}

{product.name}

{product.description}

₹{product.price} MRP ₹{product.mrp}
))}

Hotel Bookings

{featuredHotels.map((hotel) => (
{hotel.city} Open

{hotel.name}

{hotel.roomsAvailable} rooms left

₹{hotel.pricePerNight}/night Stay
))}

Taxi Booking

{featuredTaxis.map((taxi) => (
Taxi Available

{taxi.name}

Comfortable trip for Nilgiris travel

₹{taxi.pricePerTrip} Per trip
))}
{modules.map((module, index) => ( handleModuleClick(module.path)} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }} >

{module.title}

{module.description}

Explore →
))}

My Requests & Updates

{myRequests.length === 0 ? (

No requests yet. Submit a new query below.

) : ( myRequests.map((request) => (
{request.subject} {request.type}
{request.status}

{request.message}

{request.reply ? (
Admin reply:

{request.reply}

) : (
Waiting for admin response.
)}
)) )}
